pages.title: Drumhearts
pages.text:
The Drumhearts kept the beat under the whole sky. Spirit Pulse — power as rhythm before it was a number — ran from their drums along the lattice to every tribe.\
The orphan engines you find still keep their time. Listen before you feed one.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text:
Before the Cut the beat was civic: Pulse as a utility, drums as the sky's metronome, every pad on the same downbeat.\
What they lost was an audience.\
The engines did not stop.\
They had nobody left to stop for.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: You will find them still keeping time, waiting for a beat you have not struck yet.

pages.title: Spark Strand
pages.text:
*The drum is not loud. The drum is steady. Be the drum.*\
Seated. The Drumhearts answer when this Post hums.

pages.title: Their camp
pages.text: The Drumhearts keep a camp in the March steppe: huts, a fire, a Tribe Hearth, a Fire totem, a banner and four Kin — an Elder, a Drummer, a Hunter and a Weaver.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Their hearth favours copper, charged Pulse Cells, Bone Chimes. Their Elder trades Bone Chimes and Pulse Cells, and at Voice standing presses the tribe's Mark into your hand.
